sbe:messageSchema.description: LMB public market data: incremental and snapshot channels, TCP retransmission

composite.name: PacketHeader
composite.description: First 24 bytes of every UDP datagram

type.name: sessionId
type.description: Sequence space identity; identical on A and B. A change means every per-symbol sequence restarted

type.name: packetSeq
type.description: Per publisher instance and channel, from 1. Diagnostic only: NOT comparable between A and B

type.name: sendTimeNs
type.description: Publisher wall clock at send, epoch ns

composite.name: SeqHeader
composite.description: First field of every sequenced message (templateId 1..9), body offset 0

type.name: seq
type.description: Per-symbol sequence, dense from 1, identical on A and B

type.name: transactTimeNs
type.description: Cluster timestamp (epoch ns) of the log entry that caused it

type.name: flags
type.description: bit 0 END_OF_BATCH: last message of this symbol for one log entry; the book is consistent after it

validValue.name: VOLATILITY_INTERRUPTION
validValue.description: Matcher: a trade would have left the dynamic band; volatility auction started

validValue.name: VOLATILITY_AUCTION_END
validValue.description: Matcher: the volatility auction's timer uncrossed it

validValue.name: NONE
validValue.description: No trade today and no previous close: price is null

validValue.name: LAST_TRADE
validValue.description: Last trade of the trading day

validValue.name: PREVIOUS_CLOSE
validValue.description: No trade today: the previous close is carried

sbe:message.name: LevelUpdate
sbe:message.description: Price level total after the change. quantity 0 removes the level

field.name: aggressorSide
field.description: Null for auction trades

field.name: cause
field.description: Why the state changed

field.name: price
field.description: Null when the book does not cross

sbe:message.name: InstrumentDefinition
sbe:message.description: Symbol created or its parameters changed

field.name: priceBandBps
field.description: Static band half-width around the reference price

field.name: dynamicBandBps
field.description: Dynamic collar half-width around the last trade, 0 = none

field.name: volatilityAuctionNs
field.description: Length of a volatility auction, ns

sbe:message.name: ReferencePrice
sbe:message.description: The matcher applied a reference price (ReferencePriceApplied): at DayRollover (the official close), after a volatility auction that traded (the uncross price) or by command. Carries the static band now in force

field.name: bandLow
field.description: Lowest accepted limit price, inclusive

field.name: bandHigh
field.description: Highest accepted limit price, inclusive

sbe:message.name: ClosingPrice
sbe:message.description: Official close of the symbol for tradingDate. The last one before a DayRollover is the official close: positions are marked to it and it becomes the next day's reference price

field.name: price
field.description: Null when source is NONE

field.name: previousClose
field.description: Previous trading day's official close, null if none

field.name: tradingDate
field.description: yyyymmdd of the trading day being closed, 0 before the first DayRollover

sbe:message.name: SnapshotBegin
sbe:message.description: Starts one symbol's snapshot. The book equals the state after applying every sequenced message up to lastSeq

field.name: lastSeq
field.description: seq of the last sequenced message included (0 = none yet)

field.name: transactTimeNs
field.description: transactTimeNs of that message

field.name: bidLevels
field.description: Bid levels that follow in SnapshotLevels

field.name: askLevels
field.description: Ask levels that follow in SnapshotLevels

field.name: referencePrice
field.description: From the last InstrumentDefinition or ReferencePrice

field.name: bandLow
field.description: From the last ReferencePrice; null if none, or if a later InstrumentDefinition changed the reference price or priceBandBps

field.name: closePrice
field.description: Last ClosingPrice (see closeSource)

field.name: closeSource
field.description: Null when no ClosingPrice was published yet; the other close fields are then null/0

field.name: stateCause
field.description: cause of the last SymbolStatus; null if none

sbe:message.name: SnapshotLevels
sbe:message.description: Levels in order: all bids best first, then all asks best first

sbe:message.name: Heartbeat
sbe:message.description: Sent on a channel idle for heartbeatIntervalMs

sbe:message.name: RetransmitRequest
sbe:message.description: Inclusive range of one symbol's sequence

sbe:message.name: RetransmitResponse
sbe:message.description: Followed by messageCount sequenced message frames, fromSeq..toSeq

field.name: fromSeq
field.description: First seq served

field.name: toSeq
field.description: Last seq served (may be below the requested toSeq: capped, or not published yet)

field.name: oldestAvailableSeq
field.description: Oldest seq the server still holds for the symbol (0 if none)

field.name: lastSeq
field.description: Latest seq published for the symbol

sbe:message.name: SnapshotRequest
sbe:message.description: Current snapshot of one symbol over TCP. Answered with a RetransmitResponse (fromSeq = toSeq = lastSeq = the snapshot's lastSeq) followed by messageCount snapshot frames: SnapshotBegin, SnapshotLevels*, SnapshotEnd
